$comment: Restaurant identity and contact details. Fields marked PLACEHOLDER still need confirming with the client — see README.
name: fokia

address.$comment: Confirmed by the client. `street` and `city` are locale-keyed so the Greek page is not left reading a Latin transliteration of a Greek street name. VERIFY the Greek spellings before launch.

geo.$comment: PLACEHOLDER — needed for the `geo` block in the JSON-LD, which is omitted entirely while these are null. Read them off Google Maps at the pin for Laskou 3.

hours.$comment: Confirmed by the client. `days` uses schema.org day names for the JSON-LD. A `closes` earlier than `opens` means the following day, so 00:00 reads as midnight. Any day not listed in `entries` renders as closed.

$socialComment: Order here is the order shown in the nav and the footer. `id` selects the icon in components/SocialLinks.astro — an id with no matching icon is skipped, so add the icon before adding the network.

seo.$comment: PLACEHOLDER — `url` must be the real production domain before launch (canonical, OG, sitemap and robots.txt all derive from it).
